name: Mascot Outfit Switch
description: Your object as the same plush mascot wearing a tiny astronaut suit; then it spins around once. With a before/after reveal.

photo.label: A clear photo of the object (a toy, a product, a mascot)

fixed.motion_prompt.text: It spins around once. Smooth, natural motion; the subject stays recognisable. Static shot: the camera holds steady and the background stays still.
fixed.keyframe_prompt.text: Image 1 is a photo of a object. Remake the object from image 1 completely as the same plush mascot wearing a tiny astronaut suit: change its material and style all the way, but keep its shape, colors and details so it is clearly the same object. The object is the only subject in the picture. Vertical framing, high detail, a clean unmarked photo.
